intent: Original athlete cutouts for five website start-method cards and the actual iPhone start selection and ready screens.
reference: User's card-layout reference is design inspiration only. No competitor image or app screenshot was used to generate these athletes.
backgroundRemovalApproval: Owner explicitly approved local background removal and requested magenta/green key backgrounds. Preserve native alpha where present; remove magenta from the touch and voice images.

Asset type: original premium sports photography cutout for a TrackSpeed website feature card.
Create ONE photorealistic adult athlete, with impeccable natural anatomy and authentic sprint technique. The finished image will be cut out and placed over a pale blue editorial card, so no typography or graphical UI should be drawn. Premium commercial sports photography, realistic skin texture, detailed technical fabric, crisp fast-shutter action, warm soft directional daylight with clean neutral fill. Full body, both shoes and every hand completely in frame with generous 10 percent clear margins; centered composition, roughly square image. No visible clothing logos, no watermarks, no ornamental objects, no duplicated limbs.
Background: flat saturated chroma-key magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside the subject and any explicitly specified phone. Include magenta between limbs and fingers. No floor, no track patch, no scenery, no cast shadow, no gradient, no magenta light spill. This background will be removed locally into true alpha. Preserve natural neutral highlights and make the silhouette easy to separate.
Subject and action: A powerful Black woman sprinter in her late twenties, natural hair tied into a compact ponytail, wearing a deep navy sleeveless sprint singlet and fitted navy running shorts, clean white sprint spikes. Side profile facing right, captured upright at full speed in a natural mid-flight sprint stride: front knee driven high, opposite arm forward, rear leg following through. Relaxed hands, focused eyes looking ahead, excellent athletic posture. This is a flying start already at speed, not a crouching start. Athlete only, no phone.
